title: Model options move from aliases to parameters
summary:
Model choices got clearer, Command A+ gained image input, and legacy responses now carry attribution.

Trellis 2 now takes a `resolution` parameter, Perplexity Sonar uses `web_search_options.search_context_size`, and Grok selects its reasoning deployment through `reasoning_effort`. Older model IDs still resolve, but their names no longer select those behaviors on their own.

Inkling now passes reasoning settings and tool schemas through to OpenRouter. Command A+ passes messages, reasoning settings, and tools through to Azure, and its model listing now includes image input.

Legacy image responses now include a Pollinations lockup, while successful legacy image and text responses include attribution headers available to browser clients. The `nologo` parameter is still accepted but no longer removes branding.

daily.title: Choose Trellis 2 resolution
daily.text: Set `model=trellis-2` and choose `resolution=low`, `medium`, or `high`. Low is the default; output cost follows the selected resolution. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models).

daily.title: Set Perplexity search context
daily.text: Choose Perplexity Sonar’s search context with `web_search_options.search_context_size` rather than a model-name variant. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models).

daily.title: Select Grok reasoning
daily.text: Use `reasoning_effort` to select Grok’s reasoning deployment; the old reasoning model name no longer selects it by itself. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models).

daily.title: Images for Command A+
daily.text: `command-a-plus` now lists image input alongside text. Its messages, reasoning settings, and tools pass through without model-specific rewriting. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=command-a-plus).
